## D — Accuracy and source flags: Occupant protection, load and trip planning

Source basis: every knowledge block names one physical page of the hash-bound South Dakota handbook; the sentence is paraphrased and is not an official question.
A separate same-model fact-check receipt records each draft fact and its qualifier review before outbox submission; independent factual QA remains pending.
Preserve the legal excerpts’ public-road, vehicle-manufacture, forward-motion, age and pre1966 exception conditions. The carrier paragraph and seat guide describe dated publication contents, not current child-seat recommendations; infant age, weight, recline angle and shield claims remain blocked for current safety verification. [A26] [A27] [A28]
The cover lacks extracted text and is not visually cleared. The edition observation is on the back matter; no image-only content was converted into a learner fact.
Unknown official exam statistics remain null. No legal or clinical opinion is asserted beyond the official handbook’s own driving guidance.

corpus_stability.reason: The official dated snapshot is pinned, but revision frequency has not been measured. Unknown cadence remains blocked for release pending the section-A verification debt; this is not a claim that the handbook is volatile.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical pages26–27 contain historical carrier/seat guidance, including approximate age, weights, recline angle, forward-facing and shield arrangements. Verify against current issuer/manufacturer or regulator guidance before learner-facing safety release; preserve the snapshot only as publication evidence.
Physical page28 crash-distance statistics and speed/height analogy have no dated primary study in the excerpt. Verify before presenting as current quantitative safety evidence.
